text.Breeding Site:
How to play ==
While Breeding Site is in play, if you played a base this turn (including Breeding Site itself), you gain 5 Combat. Breeding Site is a base with a defense of 7. 
 Strategy ==
Breeding Site is a very strong card if you have a base-heavy deck, when it can consistently generate the 5 Combat (which is a lot for a base), and is not easily taken out. Note that you do not need other Blob cards for this card to be useful, since it does not need allying. If this is your only (or one of your only) bases, it is probably not very strong: your opponent can bypass it to attack other bases or your HQ and just leave it in play, because as long as you don't play other bases it does not generate any damage. In that case it is only useful if you really need a Blob ally, which it can provide for multiple turns since this base has a defense of 7.
